evidence_class.hiperco: measured (supplier-typical, strip specimens; typed table values)
evidence_class.armco: digitized (supplier-typical curves; PDF vector paths, no raster digitising)

applicability: room-temperature DC normal magnetization curves; no temperature dependence (H1F-MA-03 / MA-04 hot-use limits TBD): the hot-pole B-H is NOT covered
anhysteretic use of the normal curve; coercivity (Hiperco 45-125 A/m) and remanence are neglected

strip (Hiperco) / bulletin-representative (ARMCO) specimens; machined bulk parts after the specified anneal are assumed to lie inside the LO..HI bracket (assumed; verify on the procured lot, HW-MC-13)

hiperco50_p3.locator: SRC-HIPERCO50 p. 3 'DC PROPERTIES', 0.014 in (0.355 mm) strip: coercivity from 8 kA/m, DC relative permeability mu max, B (tesla) at 400/800/1600/4000/8000/16000 A/m

armco_fig7.locator: SRC-ARMCO PDF p. 8 (printed p. 6) Fig. 7 'Representative low and medium induction values for annealed ARMCO Pure Iron' (after recrystallization anneal); vector path, log H axis 1..10 000 A/m, B axis 0..2.0 T

armco_fig8.locator: SRC-ARMCO PDF p. 9 (printed p. 7) Fig. 8 'High induction magnetization curve for ARMCO Pure Iron' (intrinsic flux density B - mu0 H); vector path, log H axis 500..500 000 A/m, B_i axis 1.50..2.20 T

armco_fig9.locator: SRC-ARMCO PDF p. 10 (printed p. 8) Fig. 9 'Relative permeability of ARMCO Pure Iron over a range of magnetizing field strength': the two drawn boundary strokes of the shaded bands (lower = lower edge of the SRA / recrystallization-anneal range, 700-900 C; upper = upper edge of the normalization-anneal range, >= 927 C); log H 10..10 000 A/m, log mu_r 100..10 000

HC-NOM.rule: magnetic-anneal 0.355 mm row; 0 -> 400 A/m by the secant from the origin (relative permeability 2.10 / (mu0 400) = 4178 < mu_max 18000, i.e. LOWER than the real knee: conservative)
HC-NOM.extrapolation: above the last tabulated point B = B_last + mu0 (H - H_last) (saturated slope; FE-solver extrapolation rule)

HC-LO.rule: mechanical-anneal 0.355 mm row (lower curve); 0 -> 400 A/m by the secant
HC-LO.extrapolation: above the last tabulated point B = B_last + mu0 (H - H_last) (saturated slope; FE-solver extrapolation rule)

HC-HI.rule: magnetic-anneal row with the low-field segment at the sourced mu_max (18000) up to 2.0 T, then the table: B / (mu0 H) <= mu_max everywhere (upper permeability bound)
HC-HI.extrapolation: above the last tabulated point B = B_last + mu0 (H - H_last) (saturated slope; FE-solver extrapolation rule)

FE-NOM.rule: Fig. 7 representative curve up to H = 1.751e+04 A/m (B = 2.002 T), then Fig. 8 (B = B_i + mu0 H) for larger H where it lies above; 0 -> first digitized point by the secant from the origin
FE-NOM.extrapolation: above the last tabulated point B = B_last + mu0 (H - H_last) (saturated slope; FE-solver extrapolation rule)

FE-LO.rule: Fig. 9 lower envelope (SRA band lower edge), B = mu0 mu_r H up to H = 8378 A/m (B = 1.861 T), then Fig. 8 (B = B_i + mu0 H) for larger H where it lies above; 0 -> first digitized point by the secant from the origin
FE-LO.extrapolation: above the last tabulated point B = B_last + mu0 (H - H_last) (saturated slope; FE-solver extrapolation rule)

FE-HI.rule: Fig. 9 upper envelope (normalization band upper edge), B = mu0 mu_r H up to H = 8378 A/m (B = 1.9 T), then Fig. 8 (B = B_i + mu0 H) for larger H where it lies above; 0 -> first digitized point by the secant from the origin
FE-HI.extrapolation: above the last tabulated point B = B_last + mu0 (H - H_last) (saturated slope; FE-solver extrapolation rule)
